licenses.text:
TESTAMENTA MARRA, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/dif/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/dif/copyright.htm):
> The New Testament in the Dieri language of Australia
> Public Domain
> Language: Dieri
> Translation by: J. G. REUTHER, C. STREHLOW, jaura jinkmietja wulana
> 2023-07-26

Why this is public domain:
Translators: Johann Georg Reuther, 1861-1914, and Carl Strehlow, 1871-1922, with Dieri speakers named in eBible's statement as a group. Text: "Testamenta marra", Tanunda, South Australia, G. Auricht, 1897 (preface dated Bethesda, November 1895). US: published before 1931. Australia: life plus 70 years; Strehlow died in 1922, so the term ended in 1992.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=dif), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/dif/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carl_Strehlow; Wikidata Q94531617; https://nla.gov.au/nla.obj-1184515693/view; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
